title: After End Turn advanced to player-1's turn 5, Keeper of Masks and its two Reflection token copies were correctly killed by Temporary at the start of the Beginning Phase, but the global trash count went 0 -> 3: the two Reflection tokens (ids token-reflection-*) were placed in the trash and remained there for the whole of turn 5's main phase (trace step 38 later shows trash=1, i.e. they were only sw
expected: The Beginning-phase Temporary kill (riftbound-flow.ts:364-367) does a bare `context.zones.moveCard({cardId, targetZoneId:"trash"})` for every Temporary permanent, tokens included, and nothing in the beginning/channel/draw/main onBegin hooks calls performCleanup/runStateMaintenance afterwards (grep: no cleanupAndFireDeaths/runStateMaintenance/removeCardFromGame anywhere in riftbound-flow.ts). The only token sweep is sweepOffBoardTokens at cleanup/state-based-checks.ts:72-87, invoked from performCleanup step 0 (line 252), which runs via the withPostMoveCleanup wrapper inside the move reducer. In core rule-engine.ts the reducer (line 571) executes before the deferred flow transitions (pendingPhaseEnd -> flowManager.nextPhase at line 623-635), so endTurn's post-move cleanup fires before the next turn's Beginning phase, and the tokens trashed by Temporary sit in the trash until the next move triggers cleanup. Trace matches: step36 base has Keeper + 2 token-reflection-*, trash=0; step37 (turn 5 main) trash=3; step38 (after next End Turn move) trash=1.
rule: 186.1 (tokens cease to exist off-board) / Keeper of Masks (unl-081-219) Temporary + Reflection tokens
